context:
Goal: on a phone, you can read an item's detail and still see where it sits in the scene.
Problem (goal): a 390-wide screen fits the scene or the panel well, not both at full size.
Based on (read): lane notes item 11 (branch 3d-browser-dummy, 78a27bce); both drawn at 390, light and dark checked.
Departs from: main — adds a phone detail panel for the 3D scene.
Meanwhile: the lane builds on a.

options.gain: The scene stays in view while you read.
options.how: Tap an item; its detail opens below the scene.
options.label: Panel under the scene
options.lose: You scroll to reach the detail.

options.gain: The detail shows at once, with no scroll.
options.how: Tap an item; its detail slides up over the scene.
options.label: Panel over the scene
options.lose: It covers the scene until you close it.

title: 3D dummy on a phone: where does an item's detail panel sit?
why: Recommended a: the scene stays in view while you read.
